product_overview: ForgeHub is a guided workspace for technical teams and individuals to document, organize, and present their project work. It combines authentication, profile and workspace settings, and team member management into a structured product environment for technical creation.
core_goals: Sign in to access a personal workspace

features.name: User Login
features.description: Allows a user to access the app using their email and password.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> See authenticated workspace access

features.name: Profile Settings
features.description: Lets a signed-in user update personal profile information such as name, bio, username, and social links.
user_flows: Navigate to /w/default/settings/profile -> Fill in display name -> Fill in bio -> Save changes -> See updated profile details

features.name: Workspace Settings
features.description: Lets a signed-in user update general workspace information.
user_flows: Navigate to /w/default/settings/workspace -> Fill in workspace name -> Save changes -> See updated workspace details

features.name: Workspace Members
features.description: Lets a signed-in user review current workspace members and invite additional members.
user_flows: Navigate to /w/default/settings/members -> View list of members -> Invite a member -> Fill in email and role -> See invite prepared for the workspace

features.name: Account Settings
features.description: Lets a signed-in user view account information and delete their account if they choose.
user_flows: Navigate to /w/default/settings/account -> View account details -> Choose to delete account -> Confirm deletion -> See account removal complete

routes.description: User profile settings (Name, Bio, Username, Socials)
